Evaluation of low back pain with associated left leg symptoms, present and gradually worsening.

History
The patient reports aching low back pain that radiates into the left buttock and down the posterior left thigh and calf. She describes intermittent tingling along the left leg. Tenderness noted over the left lumbar paraspinal muscles and left sacroiliac region. Lumbar range of motion is reduced, with pain on forward flexion and on left lateral bending. No midline spinal tenderness appreciated.
